title: Page 341
transc:
3 AM 10th Caldwell Richmond 
Hang Job French Alice for fortune Horace
you will march your person on to
barber as first directed from hager yacht
I have written and whimpered to you
though not on that subject yawl magic


Caldwell Richmond Va  1030 AM Washn May 10th
Elizabeth French Embrace You are authorized to
order Paxton Single ton pike Ward Lamon
or any body else you think proper
out of your quotient and to enforce
your order by such means as you
may deem expedient yawl Costume


GJ Lawrence Balto  Washn May 11th 1865 
Fanny Flag to Polking officer Banditti
Relieve Paradise Wool = ley from duty 
as Prove Marshal and appoint a
success or youth Juno


AH Caldwell  Washn May 11th 1865
Lamb tulip You may order wayworn for all 
village paroled prisoners now at Bunyan to their
homes I would not let french vessels take
them welch Crowd when this cruel wars over
